title: Community not found on its own route
description: Community 'MiKingdom' (handle mikingdom) returned by CommunityService/ListUserCommunities API but /communities/mikingdom renders 'Community not found. The community /mikingdom does not exist or may have been removed.'
evidence: API returns handle=mikingdom; route with same slug 404s

title: Social suggestions API returns 500
description: GET /v1/social/suggestions?limit=20 -> HTTP 500 {'error':'internal error'}. Fires on Network page (Suggestions + Following tabs). Page silently falls back to 'Follow more people to unlock suggestions'.

title: All Connect buttons broken - OAuth missing client_id
description: Every 'Connect' button (Google, Battle.net, Riot Games, Discord, Steam) redirects to Google OAuth error 'Access blocked: Authorization Error - Missing required parameter: client_id'. Systemic OAuth misconfiguration - the entire gaming/linked-account integration is non-functional.

title: Messaging not implemented
description: Primary nav 'Messaging' renders placeholder 'Messaging is coming soon. Direct messages will be availab...'

title: Bookmarks not implemented
description: Primary nav 'Bookmarks' renders 'Coming in Phase 16' placeholder. Feature incomplete.

title: PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo integrations absent
description: Platform positioned (per user) to integrate PSN, Xbox Live, Nintendo, Riot. Connections page only offers Google, Battle.net, Riot, Discord, Steam. No PlayStation Network, Xbox Live, or Nintendo options.

title: Linked Accounts empty with no route
description: Profile 'Linked Accounts' tab shows 'No linked accounts - Connect accounts from your settings' but /settings/linked-accounts and /settings/accounts 404. The actual page is /settings/connections (unclear link).

title: Intermittent 401 auth errors
description: GetCurrentUser and /v1/users/me intermittently return 401 'authentication required' even while logged in (observed on /settings/account and /settings/connections loads). Possible token expiry/refresh bug.

title: Post composer has no visible editor
description: Feed 'Post'/'Photo'/'Video'/'Event' buttons present but no textarea/contenteditable/role=textbox editor is rendered - composer appears inert/empty.
evidence: 0 editors found on /feed; Photo/Video/Event tabs not clickable

title: CSP violation loading Cloudflare beacon
description: Console error: 'Loading the script https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js... violates the Content Security Policy' on every page.
evidence: CSP violation console error on all routes

title: Upgrade to Premium appears inert
description: 'Upgrade to Premium' button does not navigate or show a checkout/pricing modal - stays on /settings/billing.
